text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I walk into a diner to find a
troubled
Wonder Acute surrounded by a
mountain of food.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I tried to order normally, but I was
told I
had to use this new-fangled
"table-ette" thingy.
choice_data_list: すごい量の料理だけど……

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I didn't quite understand what I was
tapping, and
before I knew it, all this
food showed up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, now, I never said I couldn't eat all this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who tapped all those
delicious
pictures and ordered it all,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That being said, this is much more than I
usually
eat, so it could affect my caloric
intake. What to
do, what to do...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that would be wonderful, dearie.
That will
clear this problem right up.
choice_data_list: 食べたいなら食べちゃおう

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: So, shall we split it fifty-fifty?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer. Put your hands together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute and I share the
feast she
accidentally ordered and enjoy
every bite.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're quite right. That's what I
was
thinking back when I was tapping
away.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that really lifts a weight
from my
shoulders. I can dig in with an
easy conscience
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute enjoys the food
to her
heart's content.
